hero.title: Experience imbody yourself
hero.intro: A mirror that coaches you is not something you read about on a screen. It is something you feel. Set aside a quiet moment and discover, at your own pace, what digital resistance and an AI coach mean for your training.

items.title: In the showroom
items.text: Visit by appointment and train a full session on an imbody set up for you. Take your time, ask anything, and enjoy a coffee afterwards.

items.title: At your home
items.text: We bring a unit to you. You see straight away how imbody fits your space, and together we find the best spot for it.

items.title: Online video demo

items.a: Nothing. A demo in the showroom, at home or online is free of charge and you are not committing to anything.
Comfortable sportswear and clean trainers or socks. For a demo at home we need roughly 2 by 2 metres of free space.

items.q: Can I do the demo with my partner or team?
items.a: We would love that. imbody supports multiple user profiles, so it helps if everyone who will be training experiences it straight away.

meta.title: About us
meta.description: Dadelsteen brings intelligent strength training with imbody to homes and businesses in the Netherlands and Belgium. Read our story and how we work.

hero.title: Strength from the core
hero.intro: We believe getting stronger does not have to be a gym ritual. With intelligent technology, we bring coached strength training to the places where you live and work.

story.label: Our story
story.title: What a date stone taught us
paragraphs: A date stone is small, unassuming and remarkably hard. It carries everything it needs to grow into a palm that withstands desert wind and drought. Strength that comes from within, patient and lasting.
That is how we see training. Not as quick results or heavy iron racks, but as a strong core that carries you for a lifetime: in your back, your posture and your energy.

Dadelsteen is a Dutch company with a single aim: making intelligent strength training accessible to homes and businesses in the Netherlands and Belgium. With personal advice, careful installation and support close by.
story.quote: Getting stronger starts small. At the core.

items.title: Strength as a foundation
items.text: Muscle strength is the foundation of ageing well. That is why strength training is at the heart of what we do, at any age.

items.title: Technology that disappears
items.text: The best technology does not draw attention. It guides, measures and motivates, and simply lets you train.

items.title: Calm at home
items.text: A silent, elegant device that suits your interior, instead of a corner full of equipment.

items.title: Honest advice
items.text: We recommend what suits you. Even if that means waiting a little longer or choosing something else.

items.title: Personal advice
items.text: In the showroom, at your home or online. We take time for your goals, your space and your questions.

items.title: Delivery & installation
items.text: We deliver, assemble and calibrate imbody in the right spot, so you can start straight away.

items.title: Local support
items.text: Questions, updates or service: you have a dedicated point of contact in the Netherlands and Belgium.
